newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leading indicator rises 0.9 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Canada leading indicator rises 0.9 pct in March.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 0.9 percent in March to 190.6 (base 1981) after a 1.0 percent rise in February, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed", reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, rose 0.6 percent in the month to 193.3.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast the smoothed index to rise 0.9 percent.
